caption: The drawing depicts two views of a carved bird figure, likely made of wood, positioned against a plain, light beige background. The bird is colored in dark brown with reddish undertones and has a patterned texture on its body that resembles feathers, created with lighter brown or reddish hues. The upper view shows the bird in profile, perched on a small base with its beak open and head tilted upwards. The wings are folded close to the body, and the tail and legs are also visible. The lower view displays the bird from above, highlighting the outstretched wings and tail feathers, with symmetrical feather-like markings along the back and wings. The drawing focuses on the details and shape of the bird sculpture from different angles, with no additional objects present in the composition.
